mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 91 degrees near the Verona Public Library, along with a moderate air quality index of 55.

The City of Verona is launching a trishaw bike program where volunteers pilot a three-wheeled electric-assist bike for residents along the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, the Plan Commission will review several developments on August 3, including a proposed pickleball court addition at 1162 Laser Street.

Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, local hotspots are busy with Hop Haus trivia, Quizmasters trivia at Lake Louie, and more throughout the week including concerts in the park and live music at Bailey's Run.
In our weekly look at police activity, we noted an incident from July 13 where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
